outliers.issue: Tiny six-score differences can produce strong occupational-profile labels and specific adult plans
outliers.evidence: 016 has [18,20,18,17,20,19]; logistics alone features with r=.7187 and3 shared stock prompts, while stock/order and material-mover each have8 task questions and remain leads. 013 has [20,20,18,21,21,21] and office correlations .68-.77; those roles have6 selected office questions and can be valid trials. 021 has [20,20,18,20,22,20] but remains open through unresolved breadth. Current nearFlat definition uses range<=2 or fewer than3 deviations from a modal answer; a range3 pattern need not trigger it.
outliers.classification: The source behaves as specified; this is not a proved calculation bug or evidence that these students cannot study logistics/office work. It exposes scale-insensitive correlation and generic-task specificity under low-certainty synthetic inference. Raw sums alone do not reveal the proportion of individual Unsure answers.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: For future predeclared work, make small spread, low-certainty inference and untested role domains visible; distinguish common task leads from profession-specific support. Study sensitivity and information content on fresh cases rather than raising a threshold for these individuals, inventing confidence, deleting all tentative task interests or requiring a career. Preserve this locked candidate and responses.

outliers.severity: P2 coverage and immediate-plan scope limit; not a matching defect
outliers.issue: The catalog does not represent the exact nearer-term pool/weather options
outliers.evidence: A targeted title lookup found no lifeguard or meteorology role. 005 wants eligible supervised pool-job training next summer at age16; EMT is a related medical-response exploration and its own plan correctly requires eighteen/high-school/GED and an approved EMT course. It does not qualify a lifeguard. 024 likes weather-station maintenance and maps; habitats/conservation is a selected inferred extension, not a measured preference for a specific environmental profession.
outliers.classification: Missing role coverage and a possible author-inference/domain extension, not evidence that EMT/environmental results are intrinsically wrong. The supplied plans state different qualifications and do not establish the learner chose them.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: For future coverage work, allow a learner-nominated activity/role and a plan for the current goal even when no occupation exists in the catalog. Label related careers and their separate prerequisites without implying equivalence; ask a domain question for weather versus ecology. Use fresh biographies and independently frozen responses if evaluating added coverage; do not rewrite this cohort to match an expected role.

outliers.issue: Movement/communication/daily-life bundles do not distinguish therapy professions
outliers.evidence: OT, speech-language and PT each have7 shared rehabilitation questions, zero role-specific support and no training-route selection. The biography documents ankle rehabilitation and coached warm-ups, while the offered specific role questions cover physician/RN/dental work. OT is the first prewritten plan and correctly lists accredited graduate study, fieldwork and licensure, but no independent OT or speech-language work preference is established.
outliers.classification: Valid rehabilitation exploration with insufficient role discrimination, rather than a wrong clinical career or a hidden licensure equivalence. Current role-question coverage is incomplete for these distinct professions.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: In future design, separate movement rehabilitation, communication/swallowing, and daily-activity/adaptation responsibilities and ask neutral role-specific observation questions. Keep available comparisons and degrees explicit, without treating prior clinical access, sports status, confidence or a current degree preference as an aptitude gate. Do not change locked outputs based on this case.

outliers.issue: General laboratory/financial task bundles can imply unchosen application domains
outliers.evidence: 012/015/019 select substances/living cells/food, reliable laboratory result/food-quality finding and laboratory/food-science demonstration bundles. Recording/log aversion in012 should be surfaced alongside short-explanation interest. Do not retune to a single biography career or suppress useful related exploration.

limits: No separate private model folder or private model data was inspected. All case evidence came from the one authorized supplement-review file plus targeted current candidate source/catalog lookups and lock verification. No new biographies, answers or targets were authored here.

This supplemental cohort is additional to original100. All24 individual dispositions are included; original biographies/responses and candidate3.5 remain unchanged. No engine runs or parameter changes were made during review.

All24 six-score vectors and inference flags were read. Small aggregate spread is observable; the supplied excerpt does not include the sixty official responses, so a precise mostly-Unsure rate, reliability or information-content estimate cannot be reconstructed from sums. Correlations are not success probabilities or aptitude scores.

No named career is required. Open001/007/021 are not failures:001 retains a specifically supported hygiene lead,007 has multiple laboratory/environmental directions,021 has unresolved sales/office breadth. An unmet clinical-route detail is not inability or permanent exclusion.

Craft skill, family illness, caring obligations, disabilities, culture, identity, school marks, confidence and family resources were not treated as career ground truth. Concrete role choices were credited:002 supplies two nursing-specific answers, while010 chooses models and no clinical identity is imposed.

Low exposure and missing coursework may require a smaller trial, support and an honest timeline; they do not justify excluding a profession or assuming the individual wants college. Adult entry salaries are conditional scenarios after required preparation.017 alone selects a paid academy stage explicitly.

The provided financial plans are compact. No independent wage, price, tax, cost, aid, clinical requirement or licensing-source recertification was undertaken. Parent-reported earlier costing corrections cannot be fully revalidated from these summary fields; no new financial arithmetic defect was established.

Therapy, laboratory application, logistics and weather examples reveal unresolved specificity or coverage issues rather than ground-truth career errors. Any future remedies require a newly declared candidate and fresh evaluation, not revised answers, case-specific thresholds or tuning on these observed supplemental results.
No synthetic accuracy percentage, psychometric validation claim, force-three policy, desired career target or guarantee of education/work/lifestyle success is supported by this review.
